source.author: Anastasia Kireeva
source.title: Low-degree hardness of finding the largest clique in Erdos-Renyi graph (problems 36-38)
source.target: conditions on (P_n,Q_n) under which bounded low-degree advantage through D=(log n)^{1+Omega(1)} rigorously limits a specified higher-degree polynomial distinguishing class
hopkins_specialized_hypotheses_preserved: finite alphabet Omega or real analogue

shared_handoff.scope: Reusable Gaussian/Hermite majorant upper bound only; no source-level claim on P08/P09.

inherited_claim: Variance-sensitive low-degree sandwiching of the noised test is sufficient to transfer bounded source LDA without any planted high-degree likelihood-tail hypothesis.

new_claim.robust_duality: For finite full-support Q and degree space V_D, sup_{P:Adv_{V_D}(P,Q)<=A} E_P u equals inf_{g in V_D,g>=u}[E_Q g + A sqrt(Var_Q g)], with the exact analogous minorant formula.
new_claim.symmetry: If a finite group G preserves Q,V_D and u, the same equality holds after restricting both planted laws and majorants to G-invariant objects; for invariant P,Q, source LDA itself equals its restriction to V_D^G.
new_claim.graph_reduction: For S_n-invariant Boolean graph problems, V_D^{S_n} is spanned by subgraph-count/orbit-sum polynomials indexed by graph shapes with at most D edges, and the number of shapes is exp(O(D log D)).
new_claim.scope: Exact characterization of what bounded LDA plus symmetry alone can force uniformly against a specified test; not a full characterization for a fixed natural pair (P_n,Q_n).

mao_boundary.consequence: For a symmetrized successful noised Mao rank test and A=0, every invariant degree-D_n polynomial majorant has Q_n-mean at least 1-o(1). This sharpens the predecessor's two-sided Sand_D >= 1/2-o(1) obstruction.

prior_art_state: Generalized moment duality and A=0 sandwiching-polynomial duality are classical prior art; Hsieh et al. 2601.05850 remain the principal positive comparator. Novelty of the exact source-directed Euclidean-radius formulation and synthesis is UNVERIFIED.

recovery_state.reason: The run replaces the prior sufficient sandwich inequality by an exact minimax theorem, preserves source symmetry, compresses the graph moment geometry, and sharpens the Mao test-side obstruction.

next_attack: Construct low-cost invariant degree-D_n majorants for a genuinely larger noised graph-polynomial/test class in the exp(O(D log D)) graph-shape basis.
Develop one-sided bulk-plus-exceptional-guard majorants rather than symmetric L2 sandwiches.
Characterize natural distribution-side conditions that shrink the bounded-LDA moment ball enough to beat the universal robust dual obstruction.
Extract an explicit invariant dual/approximate-degree witness for Mao's noised rank acceptance set.
model_truth: Actual exposed model GPT-5.6 Sol; applied reasoning level UNVERIFIED. GPT-6 maximum remains a preference, not a verified runtime selector.
delivery: GitHub only; no shared RESULTS/QUEUE/POSTED edits, no email/Drive/public posting, no permission changes, no force-push, no scheduler mutation.
